title: The Latest: An Ideal Witness for the Democrats

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: Tonight, allegations of a White House cover-up as details of a whistleblower's complaint are revealed.
sentences.zh: 今晚，随着举报人投诉细节的披露，白宫涉嫌掩盖真相的指控浮出水面。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，简直完美。

sentences.en: In that call, the president asked for an investigation of Democratic presidential hopeful Joe Biden and his son Hunter.
sentences.zh: 在那次通话中，总统要求调查民主党总统候选人乔·拜登和他的儿子亨特。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院

sentences.en: Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 正式推进弹劾调查。

sentences.en: Now the burden is on the
sentences.zh: 现在，民主党人的重任

sentences.en: Democrats, really, to tell Americans the story of what happened and why it's impeachable.
sentences.zh: 在于向美国人民讲述发生了什么以及为什么这构成弹劾。

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: This is the first in a series of public hearings the committee will be holding as part of the House's impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 这是委员会作为众议院弹劾调查的一部分所要举行的系列公开听证会的第一场。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: I'm in the
sentences.zh: 我现在在《纽约时报》

sentences.en: Washington Bureau of the Times.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿分社。

sentences.en: It is day one of the public hearing phase of the impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天是弹劾调查公开听证阶段的第一天。

sentences.en: We just heard from the two witnesses who testified jointly, both our senior diplomats,
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚听取了两位联合出庭作证的资深外交官的证词，

sentences.en: George Kent and William Taylor.
sentences.zh: 乔治·肯特和威廉·泰勒。

sentences.en: And I'm going to grab Julie Davis, who was the congressional editor of the Times, and we're going to talk about what just happened.
sentences.zh: 接下来我将找来《纽约时报》国会编辑朱莉·戴维斯，我们来聊聊刚刚发生的事情。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Julie, what's the latest?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，最新情况如何？

sentences.en: So day one of the impeachment hearings begins with the top Republican and the top Democrat on the Intelligence Committee.
sentences.zh: 弹劾听证会的第一天，是由情报委员会的资深共和党人和资深民主党人开始的。

sentences.en: If this is not impeachable conduct, what is?
sentences.zh: 如果这不属于应予弹劾的行为，那什么才是？

sentences.en: Laying out their competing narratives for this whole phase of the impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 他们为弹劾调查的整个阶段各自阐述了相互竞争的叙事。

sentences.en: The main performance, the Russia hoax, has ended.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯骗局这出重头戏已经落幕。

sentences.en: And you've been cast in the low-rent Ukrainian sequel.
sentences.zh: 而你被选入了低成本的乌克兰续集。

sentences.en: And honestly, going into the hearing, it seemed like Republicans had the easier job.
sentences.zh: 老实说，在听证会开始前，共和党人似乎面对着更轻松的工作。

sentences.en: Democrats had to basically make an argument to the American people about why the president should be impeached for something they don't really even fully understand.
sentences.zh: 民主党人基本上必须向美国人民论证，为什么总统应该因为一件他们甚至还不太完全理解的事情而被弹劾。

sentences.en: And the Republicans were just there to poke holes and impugn motives.
sentences.zh: 而共和党人到场只是为了挑刺和质疑动机。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但随后……

sentences.en: Thank you, Ambassador Taylor.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，泰勒大使。

sentences.en: Bill Taylor and George Kent came out.
sentences.zh: 比尔·泰勒和乔治·肯特出场了。

sentences.en: And to be honest, Democrats could not have asked for a better witness than Bill Taylor.
sentences.zh: 说实话，民主党人简直找不到比比尔·泰勒更好的证人了。

sentences.en: Ukraine is a strategic partner of the United States.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰是美国的战略伙伴。

sentences.en: Right at the top, he basically lays out the importance of the American relationship with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 一开始，他就基本上阐明了美国与乌克兰关系的重要性。

sentences.en: He says...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: Ukraine is on the front line in the conflict with a newly aggressive Russia.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰站在对抗日渐具有侵略性的俄罗斯的第一线。

sentences.en: Even as we sit here today, the Russians are attacking Ukrainian soldiers in their own country and have been for the last four years.
sentences.zh: 就在我们今天坐在这里的时候，俄罗斯人还在他们的国家境内袭击乌克兰士兵，而且这种情况已经持续了四年。

sentences.en: I saw this on the front line last week.
sentences.zh: 我上周在前线亲眼目睹了这一点。

sentences.en: The day I was there, a Ukrainian soldier was killed and four were wounded.
sentences.zh: 就在我在那儿的那天，一名乌克兰士兵阵亡，四人受伤。

sentences.en: The security that the Americans support in Ukraine, he says, is really crucial.
sentences.zh: 他说，美国对乌克兰的安全支持至关重要。

sentences.en: And he takes the committee through why that's the case.
sentences.zh: 他向委员会详细解释了为什么会这样。

sentences.en: It demonstrates to Ukrainians and Russians that we are Ukraine's reliable strategic partner.
sentences.zh: 这向乌克兰人和俄罗斯人证明了我们是乌克兰可靠的战略伙伴。

sentences.en: It is clearly in our national interest to deter further Russian aggression.
sentences.zh: 遏制俄罗斯进一步的侵略显然符合我们的国家利益。

sentences.en: And finally, as the committee is aware, I wrote that withholding security assistance in exchange for help with a domestic political campaign in the United States would be crazy.
sentences.zh: 最后，正如委员会所知，我曾写道，扣留安全援助以换取对美国国内政治竞选的帮助是疯狂的。

sentences.en: I believed that then and I believe it now.
sentences.zh: 我当时这么认为，现在也这么认为。

sentences.en: And why is this a significant moment to you?
sentences.zh: 为什么这对你来说是一个重要的时刻？

sentences.en: Because his testimony is really the reason why Democrats wanted to have these public hearings in the first place.
sentences.zh: 因为他的证词正是民主党人最初想要举行这些公开听证会的原因。

sentences.en: He is reminding people that the administration officials who have given their accounts are real people.
sentences.zh: 他在提醒人们，那些提供陈述的政府官员都是真人。

sentences.en: They're not some sort of faceless bureaucrats.
sentences.zh: 他们不是什么面目模糊的官僚。

sentences.en: They're actual flesh and blood and they know what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 他们是有血有肉的活人，而且他们知道自己在谈论什么。

sentences.en: They have expertise in their region and they are just giving the facts as they know them.
sentences.zh: 他们在该地区拥有专业知识，并且只是在如实提供他们所了解的事实。

sentences.en: Secondly, he really lays out the stakes of what's gone on here.
sentences.zh: 其次，他真正摆出了这里所涉及的利害关系。

sentences.en: He talks about it as a matter of life and death for Ukrainians and sort of answers that question that Democrats have been trying to
sentences.zh: 他将其视为乌克兰人生死攸关的事，某种程度上回答了民主党人一直试图

sentences.en: answer for the public of why people should care about what the president did or didn't do with regard to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 向公众解答的问题，即为什么人们应该关心总统对乌克兰所做或未做的事情。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, there are two Ukraine stories today.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，今天有两个关于乌克兰的故事。

sentences.en: The first is the one we're discussing this morning that you have been hearing about for the past two weeks.
sentences.zh: 第一个就是我们今天上午正在讨论的、过去两周里你一直听说的那个。

sentences.en: It's a rancorous story about whistleblowers,
sentences.zh: 这是一个充满争吵的故事，关于举报人、

sentences.en: Mr. Giuliani, side channels, quid pro quos, corruption and interference in elections.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼先生、暗道、利益交换、腐败以及对选举的干预。

sentences.en: In this story, Ukraine is merely an object.
sentences.zh: 在这个故事中，乌克兰仅仅是一个客体。

sentences.en: But there's another story.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一个故事。

sentences.en: In this second story, Ukraine is the subject.
sentences.zh: 在这第二个故事中，乌克兰是主体。

sentences.en: This one is about young people.
sentences.zh: 这个故事是关于年轻人的。

sentences.en: So what's next?
sentences.zh: 接下来是什么？

sentences.en: So there's no hearing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所以明天没有听证会。

sentences.en: But also today, there was a new element that was kind of injected into all of this, which is sort of unexpected.
sentences.zh: 但在今天，也出现了一种被注入这一切的新元素，可以说是出乎意料的。

sentences.en: Last Friday, a member of my staff told me of events that occurred on July 26th.
sentences.zh: 上周五，我的一位工作人员告诉我7月26日发生的事情。

sentences.en: We got introduced to a new character by Bill Taylor, and that's David Holmes.
sentences.zh: 比尔·泰勒向我们介绍了一个新人物，那就是大卫·霍姆斯。

sentences.en: A member of my staff could hear President Trump on the phone asking Ambassador
sentences.zh: 我的一位工作人员听到特朗普总统在电话中询问大使

sentences.en: Sondland about the investigations.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰关于调查的情况。

sentences.en: An aide of his, who he only recently learned, overheard a phone conversation between President Trump and Gordon Sondland, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他的一位助手——他最近才得知——无意中听到特朗普总统与美国驻欧盟大使戈登·桑德兰之间的一通电话，

sentences.en: ambassador to the European Union, in which Trump was directly asking about investigations that he wanted.
sentences.zh: 在电话中，特朗普直接询问了他想要的调查。

sentences.en: And after the call,
sentences.zh: 而在通话结束后，

sentences.en: Following the call with President Trump, the member of my staff asked Ambassador Sondland what
sentences.zh: 在与特朗普总统通话后，我的一位工作人员向桑德兰大使询问了

sentences.en: President Trump thought about Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统对乌克兰的看法。

sentences.en: The aide asked Ambassador Sondland what the president thought of Ukraine and was told.
sentences.zh: 这位助手向桑德兰大使询问总统对乌克兰的看法，并得到了答复。

sentences.en: Ambassador Sondland responded that President Trump cares more about the investigations of Biden, which Giuliani was pressing for.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰大使回答说，特朗普总统更关心朱利安尼一直在力推的对拜登的调查。

sentences.en: He's much more interested in investigations of the Bidens.
sentences.zh: 他对调查拜登家族要感兴趣得多。

sentences.en: At the time I gave my deposition on October 22nd, I was not aware of this information.
sentences.zh: 在我10月22日作证时，我并不知道这一信息。

sentences.en: I'm including it here for completeness.
sentences.zh: 我把它加在这里是为了保持完整性。

sentences.en: David Holmes is going to be deposed on Friday, we've learned, and that indicates that even
sentences.zh: 我们获悉，大卫·霍姆斯将于周五接受闭门质询，这表明，

sentences.en: though we thought the private fact-finding phase of this investigation was drawing to a close, they're actually still trying to dig for more facts.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们原以为这次调查的私人事实查明阶段即将结束，但他们实际上仍在试图挖掘更多事实。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you, Julie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，朱莉。

sentences.en: That is the lateSt. We'll have full coverage of day one on the impeachment proceedings tomorrow on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是最新情况。我们明天将在《每日新闻》上对弹劾程序的第一天进行全面报道。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《切割机秀》中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方查找《切割机秀》。
